title: TOYO participates in Citi's "10-Hour Teach-In: The Space Economy & Future of AI" Investor Webcast
summary: TOYO Co., Ltd (Nasdaq: TOYO) (OTC: TOYWF), ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar manufacturing company, today anno unced that senior members of its leadership team participated in Citi's "10-Hour Teach-In: The Space Economy Future of AI," a full-day institutional investor webcast held on July 8, 2026, covering Space, Artificial Intelligence, Solar, and Robotics. TOYO was invited to present on the topic of solar applications in space. The Company was represented by Chief Technology Officer Aihua Wang, Chief Technical Advisor Dr. Jianhua Zhao, and Chief Strategy Officer Rhone Resch. Dr. Wang and Dr. Zhao are globally recognized authorities in high-efficiency solar cell technology. Both were previously members of the research team at the University of New South Wales that was awarded the prestigious Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering — one of the world's highest honors in engineering — for their groundbreaking contributions to high-efficiency solar cell development.
